title: urtica angustifolia var. sikokiana
intro: Urtica angustifolia var. sikokiana, commonly known as Japanese stinging nettle or Japanese wild nettle, is a plant species belonging to the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Urtica angustifolia var. sikokiana include its ability to relax muscles, improve sleep quality, and reduce stress levels. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
